newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat sees no major market improvement in 97.
newsitem.headline: Fiat sees no major market improvement in 97.

text.p: Italy's industrial giant Fiat warned that 1996 had been a difficult year, and that although the group did not see major improvements in its markets for 1997 the company pledged that it would increase profitability, according to a source at the company.
This was the message to around 500 top Fiat managers from around the world given by the company's top directors at an end of year meeting, the source said.
The message was that 1996 would prove to have been a very difficult year, and next year will only see a modest rise in markets, especially in Italian markets.
The group results will be affected by the drop in demand in the Italian car market, the slow down in the European truck market, the strength of the lira and fierce competition.
